_about: Settings for publishing every repository's Code explorer on the portfolio. Read by tools/clarity/refresh.py.
_private_repositories: notes publishes the notes, mind map and readiness but not the code. Set to full to publish private code too.

budget._about: packets_per_run caps explaining in one routine run (one packet is up to 60,000 tokens for Haiku). Unexplained sections wait for the next run.

_projects: Repository name to the slug of its project page on the portfolio, for the link back. Repositories not listed appear on the /code index only.
_visibility: Filled in during setup from GitHub (public or private). New repositories default to notes only until listed.
_overrides: Per repository, for example {"Hitman": {"mode": "notes"}} to keep a public repository's code off the site.
_graphify_version: Pinned Graphify version for code maps; set during setup from graph-layer-eval/10_pilot.md.
